# Turtleand

> Ideas, stories and tools for a little more understanding. Turtleand is an identity hub and a router to distinct spaces for reflection, learning and practice.

## Principal Spaces
- [Growth](https://growth.turtleand.com/): Reflective writing about AI, understanding, critical thinking and human agency
- [Handbook](https://handbook.turtleand.com/): Practical principles for human–AI collaboration
- [AI Atlas](https://atlas.turtleand.com/): A visual map of AI tools and related explorations
- [Chronicle](https://chronicle.turtleand.com/): Authored interactive narrative about human agency and our evolving relationship with AI

## Technical Writing
- [AI Lab](https://lab.turtleand.com/): Technical articles and hands-on learning for practical LLM tools and agents
- [Build](https://build.turtleand.com/): Technical articles on engineering fundamentals, software craft and systems

## Portal
- [Home](https://turtleand.com/): Four principal destinations and an All spaces directory with a technical writing section and public source links
- [About Turtleand](https://turtleand.com/about): The pseudonymous identity and approach behind the ecosystem
- Avatar Evolution Gallery: Open the combined Turtuan image and wordmark in the home header, or Turtuan in the landscape, or the logo on other pages, to explore six chronological canonical SVG versions, playback and manual navigation; optional 3D inspection loads on request
- [Turtleand Feeds](https://turtleand.com/feeds/): Subscribe to public written-content surfaces for Growth, Handbook, Build and AI Lab
- [Feed registry](https://turtleand.com/feeds.json): Machine-readable feed discovery
- English is available at the root; Spanish uses `?lang=es`

## Connect and Public Source
- Turtleand ecosystem on GitHub: https://github.com/turtleand
